name: Turn a content plan into LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram posts with an AI agent and publish after approval
description: Twice a week, turns the next story from the content plan into a post per network and publishes it after the author approves it. Facebook and Instagram have no ByteChef component yet, so they go through the Meta Graph API.
shortDescription: Twice a week, write a post per network from your content plan and publish it after you approve it.
keyFeatures: AI social media strategist that writes one post per network from the next story in the plan
Human approval by email before anything is published
Publishes to LinkedIn, a Facebook Page and Instagram
Marks the story as published in the content plan
prerequisites: Google Sheets and Google Mail (Gmail) connections
Facebook Page access token for the Graph API; replace REPLACE_WITH_PAGE_ID
Instagram professional account token for the Graph API; replace REPLACE_WITH_IG_USER_ID
A content plan spreadsheet; replace REPLACE_WITH_CONTENT_PLAN_SPREADSHEET_ID
idealFor: Authors and small brands that post the same story on several networks and want to approve every post first.
steps: Read the next story from the content plan in Google Sheets.
The social media strategist agent writes a post for each network.
Ask the author to approve the posts by email.
If approved, publish to LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.
Mark the story as published in the content plan.
